text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Tch. My times are getting worse. Did I 
consume too many useless calories?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's surprising. I never knew you 
could appreciate good food too, 
Shakur-kun.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah? It's only natural to find glutamic 
acid and inosinic acid delicious."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Consuming carbs triggers the release of 
insulin, which enhances serotonin 
production, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. So despite any differences in 
degree, you still harbor desires similar 
to an ordinary person's.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For Shakur-kun, here is a drug that makes 
you lose weight just by taking one pill a 
day—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Don't need it. All I gotta do is avoid 
high-calorie crap. And stop using that as 
an excuse, you're annoying."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, through rigorous 
self-discipline, Air Shakur managed to 
regain her original physique.
